items.item:
9. `[fe80::1%eth0]:8781`, `[::ffff:127.0.0.1]:8781`, `127.0.0.01:8781` and
   `127.0.0.1:08781` each stop the start, naming the item. While Registry
   runs, a second socket binding the service API's endpoint fails; an IPv4
   client cannot reach an IPv6 listener.
   Shows A17-1. [witness: verification:registry_a17_address_text_form_and_exclusive_bind]

quotes: assert diagnostic is not None, f"start passed; expected it to name {item}"
verdicts.why: The check rejects all four prohibited textual forms through `_stops`, verifies that the diagnostic names `service_listen` and that neither listener serves, detects any successful second bind while Registry runs, and confirms that an IPv4 client cannot connect to the IPv6-only listener.
